headline: German Cost-of-Living Protests Turn Violent in Frankfurt and Other Cities
summary: Protests over the cost of living turned violent in Frankfurt's city centre, resulting in looted shops. Unrest was also reported across Berlin, Hamburg, and Cologne.
why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, where sustained consumer price pressures have driven public discontent. Civil unrest and retail disruptions pose operational risks for businesses and dampen consumer confidence.

impacts.name: Germany
impacts.why: Widespread cost-of-living protests and retail looting disrupt commerce and signal heightened socioeconomic strain in Germany.
